Search & AI visibility

SEO and AI visibility for Astro websites.

An Astro website still needs useful content and a sound SEO setup. We plan page titles, internal links, sitemaps and structured data around the searches that matter to your business.

Answer engine optimisation (AEO) builds on that work. We check how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude describe your business, improve the pages buyers need, and track citations alongside visits and enquiries.

  • Buyer-question research and a visibility baseline
  • Service pages, useful content and technical improvements
  • AI citation monitoring and source checks
  • Reporting that connects findings to the next action

Before we begin

Planning your Astro website.

Is Astro a good choice for a B2B marketing website?

+

Astro suits content-heavy websites and teams that want ownership of their code. We plan the CMS, publishing controls and ongoing support around the people running the site. Our own website runs on Astro; our Webflow Enterprise experience informs the design systems and handover.

Can our marketing team edit an Astro site without a developer?

+

Yes, with a connected CMS and an agreed set of page sections. Your team can edit content, preview changes and publish within that system. We establish who needs to edit what before recommending the CMS, and include training in the handover.

How does Astro compare with Webflow?

+

Webflow offers visual page editing and managed hosting. Astro gives your team ownership of the code and flexibility over hosting, content and integrations. We work with both. The choice depends on your publishing needs, application requirements and who will maintain the site.

What does it cost to host an Astro site?

+

Hosting costs depend on traffic and the features the site needs. A static marketing site can have low running costs; a platform may also need a database, authentication, payments and other services. The proposal names those services, their expected costs and the support required.

Can you move our existing site to Astro?

+

Yes. We review the existing content and integrations, rebuild the page templates, and map old URLs to their new destinations. Redirects and key journeys are checked before launch. Search performance is monitored after the switch, with any issues investigated.

What happens after launch?

+

You keep the source code, accounts and build documentation. We can agree ongoing development, maintenance, search and AI visibility work, or hand the site over to your team. For applications, support includes the services and integrations agreed in the scope.
